title: SLED: Sensor SLicing from Edge to Datacenter
abstract: arXiv:2611.21937v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern sensing systems generate large volumes of heterogeneous data streams from multiple sensor modalities, increasing reliance on datacenters for computation, artificial intelligence/superintelligence (AI/SI) inference, and AI/SI training. Each sensor stream may have different network and compute requirements depending on its type and data volume. However, current wireless systems typically allocate resources at the device level, leading to contention among co-located sensor streams, where bulk data transfers may starve latency-critical telemetry. To this end, this paper introduces Sensor Slicing (SL). SL provides deterministic, medium access control (MAC)-level isolation for individual sensors within a single user equipment (UE) in open radio access networks (O-RAN). Using agentic coding techniques, SL is implemented in two O-RAN-compliant packages, reducing development time by 400 times (2 h 40 min [OCUDU] vs. 6.5 weeks [OAI]), 228-f

translated_title: SLED：从边缘到数据中心的传感器切片
translated_abstract: 现代传感系统会从多种传感器模态生成大量异构数据流，越来越依赖数据中心进行计算、人工智能/超级智能（AI/SI）推理以及AI/SI训练。每个传感器流可能根据其类型和数据量有不同的网络与计算需求。然而，当前的无线系统通常在设备层面分配资源，导致位于同一设备上的多个传感器流之间产生资源竞争，批量数据传输可能会“饿死”对延迟敏感的遥测流量。为此，本文提出了传感器切片技术。SL在开放无线接入网络（O-RAN）中为单个用户设备（UE）内的各个传感器提供确定性的、介质访问控制（MAC）级别的隔离。借助智能体编程技术，SL在两个符合O-RAN标准的软件包中得以实现，将开发时间缩短了400倍（2小时40分钟 [OCUDU] 对比 6.5周 [OAI]），228-f…（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出SLED传感器切片技术，在O-RAN中为单个用户设备内的各传感器流提供确定性的MAC层隔离，解决批量数据传输挤占延迟敏感遥测流量的问题，并利用智能体编程将开发时间缩短400倍。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Sensor Slicing (SL), which provides deterministic MAC-level isolation for individual sensor streams within a single UE in O-RAN, preventing bulk data transfers from starving latency-critical telemetry while cutting development time by 400x through agentic coding.
